title: A strings finder

milestone.title: Ground Rules, Tools and the PE Format

description:
Find readable text inside a binary, in ASCII and UTF-16, like the `strings` tool.

```
0x0010 ascii  "Hello from my program"
0x0030 utf16  "Settings.ini"
0x0050 ascii  "Error %d"
3 strings of at least 5 characters
```
hints: Keep the start of the current run; when a non-printable byte ends it, print it if it is long enough (lesson 1.05).
For UTF-16, step two bytes at a time and require the second byte to be 0.
requirements: ASCII: runs of printable bytes (32 to 126) of at least 5.
UTF-16LE: runs of printable characters each followed by a zero byte.
Print the offset of each in hex. Run it on a program you built yourself.
stretch: Read a real file from disk with `std::ifstream` in binary mode.
